## Selected Projects

- [AgentMagnify](https://cv.dotka.xyz/projects/agentmagnify): Live monitoring platform that verifies what AI coding agents actually did.
- [Content Generator & Distributor](https://cv.dotka.xyz/projects/content-generator): Content generation and publishing workflow platform.
- [Library Management System](https://cv.dotka.xyz/projects/library): Multi-tenant management system for small libraries.
- [Tickentra](https://cv.dotka.xyz/projects/tickentra): Ticketing and event infrastructure concept.
- [Quiz Night Platform](https://cv.dotka.xyz/projects/quiz-night): Live quiz experience system for events.
- [Automation & Data Systems](https://cv.dotka.xyz/projects/automation): Custom scraping, workflow and business automation systems.
